name: cosy-cabin
layout: A small log cabin room with a stone fireplace on the back wall, an armchair and a rug in front of it, a bed in one corner and a small table with two chairs by the window
style: cosy winter cabin, warm firelight, knitted blankets, rough timber walls, snow outside the window

name: star-bridge
layout: A star destroyer command bridge with a stunning space vista: a long hall with a raised central walkway, sunken crew pits with consoles on both sides, and a wall of tall windows at the front
style: cold grey steel military starship interior, glowing control panels, hard polished floor, stars and a planet beyond the windows

name: mushroom-grotto
layout: A round cave chamber with a shallow pool in the middle, giant mushrooms around it, boulders along the walls and a fallen log to sit on
style: glowing fungus grotto, wet organic rock, moss, soft blue and green bioluminescent light, hanging roots

name: walled-garden
layout: A walled garden with a fountain in the middle, four flower beds around it, a bench under an apple tree and a greenhouse in one corner
style: English cottage garden on a bright summer morning, old brick walls, roses and lavender, gravel paths

name: night-street
layout: A narrow city street with shop fronts on both sides, a row of street lamps, a parked car, a bus stop with a bench and a food cart at the corner
style: rainy neon-lit Tokyo back street at night, wet asphalt reflections, glowing signs, tangled overhead wires

name: clock-workshop
layout: A clockmaker's workshop with a large pendulum swinging in the middle, a slowly spinning brass orrery on a pedestal, a workbench along one wall and shelves of clocks along another
style: Victorian clockmaker's workshop, polished brass and dark walnut, warm gaslight, gears and dials everywhere

name: sky-lounge
layout: A penthouse lounge with one whole wall of floor-to-ceiling windows looking out over a city far below, a long low sofa facing the windows, a coffee table, a grand piano and a bar counter at the back
style: luxury modern penthouse at sunset, glass and pale stone, golden light, skyline and mountains beyond the windows

name: cluttered-attic
layout: A cluttered attic packed with stacked trunks and crates, an old wardrobe, a rocking horse, a dressmaker's dummy, piles of books, a rolled carpet, a standing mirror and a small round window at the end
style: dusty old attic, shafts of light through the round window, cobwebs, faded wallpaper, worn wood and brass
